name: Altelyla Croce
original_name: アルテライラ・クローチェ
source:
An inhabitant of the eastern part of Grasesta, Altelyla is the madame of the high-class brothel in East Grasesta. She first sees Judar when he is led in chains into the western part of the city.

[Spoiler] Altelyla is initially a patron of one of Dulphia's underlings, but his loss to Judar in the Artisans tournament piques her interest in Judar. She eventually befriends Judar and Lilica and helps them out through her influential network of contacts in the Grasestan elite.

Altelyla has knowledge of significant individuals outside Grasesta and involves Judar in a slave auction involving Zaur's wife and daughter. If Judar buys the pair at the auction, she arranges for them to work at her brothel as prostitutes. 

When asked by Judar why she gives him so many favours, she replies she rates him highly for his strength in combat and believes the city of Grasesta is impacted when Judar makes a significant move in the Black Pit or in events around the city. [/Spoiler]
